items.title: Why McKesson (MCK) Is Back In The Spotlight
items.summary: McKesson (MCK) is back in focus after its board affirmed a regular quarterly dividend of $0.94 per share, payable on January 4, 2027, to shareholders of record on December 1, 2026. At around $999.62 per share, McKesson has seen firm momentum recently, with a 30-day share price return of 10.79% and a 90-day move of 13.95%. A 5-year total shareholder return of 367.39% points to a powerful long-run compounding story. Scan how McKesson compares with other potential momentum and quality...

items.title: Wall Street Bulls Look Optimistic About McKesson (MCK): Should You Buy?
items.summary: Based on the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), McKesson (MCK) should be added to one's portfolio. Wall Street analysts' overly optimistic recommendations cast doubt on the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric. So, is the stock worth buying?

items.title: Will MCK's Pharma & Specialty Demand Offset Pricing Headwind in Q2?
